meta.base: Mantine 9 (component library and behaviour); tokens here map onto its theme, see the Mantine section
meta.brand: Upmo brand decision 2026-10-19: caret mark, up in Emerald, mo in Ink, Familjen Grotesk wordmark as SVG, Manrope UI, Fira Code

tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page ground. Bone in light, Ink in dark. Everything else sits on this.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Raised: cards, inputs, modals, menus, table rows.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Sunken: sidebar, code blocks, skeleton base, table header.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on rows, nav items, subtle buttons.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, selected row, active chip. Pair with `emerald-deep` text.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltips and the inverted hero band. Text on it is `ink-inverse`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, labels, primary text on every surface. 15:1 on `surface-000` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Running prose and chat replies on `surface-000` and `surface-100`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions, metadata, placeholders, timestamps on `surface-000`, `surface-100`, `surface-200`. 6.5:1 light, 7.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control text and icons only. Exempt from contrast rules; never use for live content.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `surface-inverse`.

tokens.name: ink-on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `emerald-deep` fills (primary buttons, progress fill). 5.7:1 light, 6.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: emerald
tokens.usage: The brand green: caret mark, the up in the wordmark, status icons, large text 24px+. 3.9:1 on `surface-000` light, so never for body-size text; use `emerald-deep`.

tokens.name: emerald-deep
tokens.usage: Interactive green: primary button fill, links, selected text, focus ring, progress. 5.7:1 on `surface-000` and 6.5:1 on `surface-100` in light; 6.5:1 on `surface-000` dark.

tokens.name: emerald-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of primary buttons and hovered links.

tokens.name: emerald-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: emerald-soft
tokens.usage: Light button fill, success alert ground, done badge ground. Text on it is `emerald-deep`.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Inactive progress track, skeleton shimmer high.

tokens.name: caret-idle
tokens.usage: Undrawn caret stroke: both strokes of Queued, the right stroke of Preparing and Planning. 3.4:1 on `surface-000` light, 3.9:1 dark, so the caret keeps its shape. In high contrast it stays apart from `ink`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card edges, dividers, table rules. Carries no meaning, so may sit under 3:1.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, checkboxes, radios, outline buttons. 3.4:1 on `surface-000` light, 3.9:1 dark, as WCAG asks of a control edge.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The one focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every focusable element. 5.7:1 on `surface-000` light, 6.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icon, always next to a word or the done caret, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success alert and badge ground.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs-approval and waiting states: text and icon on `warning-soft` (5.0:1 light, 7.5:1 dark) and on `surface-000`.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning alert, badge and banner ground.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed states, destructive buttons, field errors: text and icon on `danger-soft` (5.6:1 light, 6.4:1 dark) and on `surface-000`. Always paired with an X icon or the word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error alert, badge and field-error ground.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational notices: text and icon on `info-soft` (5.5:1 light, 6.8:1 dark). Blue, so it is never confused with success.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info alert and badge ground.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals and drawers.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Categorical series 1 (emerald). Fixed order, never cycled. Validated: adjacent CVD ΔE ≥ 10 both themes, ≥ 3:1 on `surface-100`.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Categorical series 2 (blue).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Categorical series 3 (amber). Last slot safe for scatter and maps; beyond three series fold to Other or facet.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Categorical series 4 (magenta). Bars, lines and stacks only.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Categorical series 5 (violet).

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Categorical series 6 (clay). Also the warm pole of the diverging scale. Never for danger; that is `danger`.

tokens.name: chart-ord-1
tokens.usage: Ordinal and sequential ramp, lightest step (near zero). Validated: monotone, ΔL ≥ 0.06, ≥ 2:1 on the surface.

tokens.name: chart-ord-2
tokens.usage: Ramp step 2.

tokens.name: chart-ord-3
tokens.usage: Ramp step 3.

tokens.name: chart-ord-4
tokens.usage: Ramp step 4, darkest in light, mid in dark; dark adds `chart-ord-5`.

tokens.name: chart-ord-5
tokens.usage: Ramp step 5 (dark theme only; equals step 4 in light).

tokens.name: chart-mid
tokens.usage: Neutral midpoint of the diverging scale (emerald ↔ clay) and the empty track of charts.

tokens.name: emerald-0
tokens.usage: Mantine `colors.emerald[0]`. Softest tint.

tokens.name: emerald-1
tokens.usage: Mantine `colors.emerald[1]`.

tokens.name: emerald-2
tokens.usage: Mantine `colors.emerald[2]`. Dark theme pressed fill.

tokens.name: emerald-3
tokens.usage: Mantine `colors.emerald[3]`. Dark theme hover fill.

tokens.name: emerald-4
tokens.usage: Mantine `colors.emerald[4]`. Dark theme primary shade.

tokens.name: emerald-5
tokens.usage: Mantine `colors.emerald[5]`. Dark theme brand green.

tokens.name: emerald-6
tokens.usage: Mantine `colors.emerald[6]`. The brand green.

tokens.name: emerald-7
tokens.usage: Mantine `colors.emerald[7]`. Light theme primary shade.

tokens.name: emerald-8
tokens.usage: Mantine `colors.emerald[8]`. Light theme hover.

tokens.name: emerald-9
tokens.usage: Mantine `colors.emerald[9]`. Light theme pressed.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Marketing hero only. Familjen Grotesk never appears inside the app UI; the wordmark ships as SVG.

styles.name: hero-sm
styles.usage: Marketing section titles and the hero at phone width.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: List item title, task card title.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Always-on AI agents, on infrastructure you own.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Long-running tasks that plan, execute, and review their own work.
styles.usage: Default text: chat, descriptions, table cells, inputs.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Metadata, helper text, timestamps, nav items.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, button text at size sm, badge text.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
styles.usage: Hints under composers, footnotes. Never below 12px.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase group headers in lists and sidebars.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, tool call arguments, version strings.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Inline code inside body-sm, keyboard shortcuts.

spacing.note: 4px base. Use steps, never odd values. Component padding is on the step; layout gaps use the larger steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside a badge; gap between stacked helper lines.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons; gap between chips; inside padding of small controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of inputs and medium buttons; gap between form fields in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards and fields; page content inset below `bp-md`; gap under a page title.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page content inset from `bp-md`.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Modal padding; gap between page and form sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large internal gaps in overlays and complex compositions, not page insets or default section gaps.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between major page regions; stepper content top margin.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top bar height; empty state padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Marketing section padding.

radius.note: Soft, 8px base. Radius signals an object: controls md, containers lg, overlays xl, pills full.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox box, kbd, inline code, skeleton lines.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, chips at size sm, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, tabs, table container, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, alerts, chat bubbles, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals, drawers, the composer.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, pills, avatars, switch, progress bar.

shadow.note: Borders carry structure; shadows only lift floating layers. Never shadow a card at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, popovers, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Notifications, the composer when focused, dragged items.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and drawers over `overlay`.

size.note: Control heights and icon sizes. Touch targets are 40px minimum on pointer-coarse devices, 32px minimum with a mouse.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Sidebar items, small buttons, inline inputs in tables and action icons.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, inputs and selects. Sidebar items use this only on coarse pointers. The touch minimum.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary call to action on marketing pages and onboarding.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside badges, inputs and body-sm text.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon: buttons, nav, table actions.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Empty states, feature tiles, page headers.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: App sidebar width on desktop. Collapses to an icon rail of 56px below md, a drawer below sm.

tokens.name: topbar
tokens.usage: App top bar height.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running prose, chat replies and documentation.

breakpoint.note: Mantine's defaults, in em so they follow the user's font size. Mobile first: write the phone layout, then add from `sm` up.

tokens.name: bp-xs
tokens.usage: 576px. Two-column form rows start here.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: 768px. Sidebar becomes an icon rail; cards go two across.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: 992px. Full sidebar; three-card grids.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: 1200px. Chat gets the side panel; tables show every column.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: 1408px. Content stops growing; margins absorb the rest.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Top bar, table header, stepper header.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus, selects, popovers, tooltips.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Modal and drawer scrim.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modal and drawer panel.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Notifications stack, always above modals.

motion.note: Durations and easings. Hover and colour 120ms, state 200ms, overlays 240ms in and 160ms out. The caret is the only thing that animates for longer. Everything stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, colour and border changes, press scale, tooltip fade.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: State changes: checked, expanded, selected, caret stroke, progress width, chevron rotate.

tokens.name: duration-enter
tokens.usage: Overlays entering: modal, drawer, menu, toast, popover.

tokens.name: duration-leave
tokens.usage: Overlays leaving. Always shorter than entering.

tokens.name: duration-loader
tokens.usage: One loop of the drawing caret loader.

tokens.name: duration-lift
tokens.usage: Period of the working-task lift (2px up and back).

tokens.name: duration-shimmer
tokens.usage: One pass of the skeleton shimmer.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Everything that moves or changes state.

tokens.name: ease-leave
tokens.usage: Overlays leaving: starts fast, no settle.

tokens.name: ease-caret
tokens.usage: The caret draw: quick start, long settle so the stroke looks drawn, not slid.

tokens.name: press-scale
tokens.usage: Scale of a button or tile while pressed.

tokens.name: tooltip-delay
tokens.usage: Hover delay before a tooltip shows; 0 when another tooltip was open in the last second.
